meta.title: Secure Client Intake
meta.description: Encrypted intake questionnaire and document portal for BCN Student Concierge clients.

page.title: Your file starts here.
page.intro: Six short steps. Everything you enter is transmitted over TLS and stored encrypted; uploaded identity documents are encrypted individually with their own AES-256 key.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Enter these exactly as they appear in your passport. Spanish authorities match every character, and a mismatch here is the most common cause of a rejected file.

family.title: Civil and family status
family.description: Spanish residency forms require parental given names even for adult applicants. First names only — surnames are not requested.

address.title: Address in Spain
address.description: This must match your Padrón certificate exactly, including floor and door. If you have not registered yet, use the address on your lease.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: We use these for appointment confirmations. Give the number you will actually be carrying in Spain.

nie.label: Pre-assigned NIE
nie.hint: On your visa, if issued. Leave blank if you do not have one yet.

firstSurname.label: Last name
firstSurname.hint: Your family name, as in your passport. If you have two, enter the first one here.

secondSurname.label: Second last name
secondSurname.hint: Only if your passport shows a second family name, as Spanish and Latin American passports do. Leave blank otherwise — never enter “N/A”.

givenName.label: First name(s)
givenName.hint: All your given names, exactly as in your passport.

birthDate.label: Date of birth
birthDate.hint: Choose the day, month and year as shown in your passport.

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.hint: As on your passport. It decides whether we prepare an EX-17 (TIE) or an EX-18 (EU certificate).

streetName.label: Street name
streetName.hint: Include the type: CARRER, CALLE, AVINGUDA, PASSEIG…

floorDoor.label: Floor / door
floorDoor.hint: Leave blank if the address has no floor or door.

phone.label: Mobile phone
phone.hint: International format, including the country code.

consent.title: Consent and scope
consent.intro: Each box below is unchecked by default and must be actively ticked. We do not treat silence, or a pre-ticked box, as consent.

gdprDataProcessing.label: I consent to the processing of my personal data
gdprDataProcessing.body: BCN Student Concierge may process the data above to prepare my forms, book appointments and administer my file, under GDPR Art. 6(1)(b). Data is held in the EU and deleted 30 days after service completion.

gdprSensitiveDocuments.label: I consent to the storage of my identity documents
gdprSensitiveDocuments.body: My passport, visa and enrolment documents may be stored in encrypted form for the duration of my engagement. I understand I may withdraw this consent and request deletion at any time, and that withdrawal may prevent completion of the service.

disclaimerAcknowledged.label: I understand this is not legal representation
disclaimerAcknowledged.body: I understand BCN Student Concierge is an independent administrative facilitation service, is not a law firm or gestoría, does not represent me before any authority, and does not provide binding legal or immigration advice. All applications are submitted in my own name.
disclaimerAcknowledged.error: Please acknowledge the scope of service

marketingOptIn.label: Send me arrival tips before I travel
marketingOptIn.body: Occasional practical email about arriving in Barcelona. Unsubscribe at any time. This is genuinely optional and does not affect your service.

wizard.fixEarlier: Some answers need correcting — check the earlier steps.
wizard.submitFailed: We could not save your submission. Please try again.
wizard.networkRetry: Network error. Your answers are still here — please retry.
wizard.checkoutFailed: Could not open checkout. Please try again.
wizard.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
wizard.uploadIntro: Your file is open. Reference {ref}. Upload what you have now, then continue to payment.
wizard.uploadLater: Missing something, like a Padrón document from your landlord? That is normal. Pay now and upload it later from <link>your file</link>: sign in any time with the email you gave us.
wizard.stripeNote: Card and Apple Pay, processed by Stripe. We never see your card details.

summary.govFees: Government fees (Modelo 790, card issuance) are paid by you directly to the Spanish authorities and are not included.
summary.routePending: The price depends on your nationality. It is set as soon as you choose it in the first step.

passport.label: Passport — photo page
passport.description: The page with the machine-readable zone. If your visa is in the passport, add that page too.

acceptance-letter.label: Certificado de matrícula (enrolment certificate)
acceptance-letter.description: The official enrolment certificate from your university, stamped and signed.

lease.label: Lease or property deed
lease.description: The full signed contract (or the deed, if the signer owns the flat), all pages.

utility-bill.label: Recent utility bill
utility-bill.description: Electricity, water or gas, for this address, from the last three months.

padron-authorization.label: Signed authorisation
padron-authorization.description: The authorisation form, signed by hand and dated by the person who authorises you.

authorizer-id.label: ID of the person who signed
authorizer-id.description: A clear photo or scan of their identity document — Spanish DNI, NIE card or passport — front and back.

collective-authorization.label: Authorisation from your residence
collective-authorization.description: Barcelona’s form for collective homes, signed by the residence and stamped.

documents.wrongType: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files are accepted. Please re-export the file.
documents.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
documents.footer: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to {mb} MB each. Each file is encrypted with its own AES-256 key on receipt and permanently deleted 30 days after your service completes.
documents.tooMany: Too many uploads in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

complete.title: Your file is open.
complete.intro: A confirmation and invoice are on their way to the email address you gave. Here is exactly what happens next — and the one payment you will need to make yourself.

steps.title: We verify your file (within 1 business day)
steps.body: Your uploads are checked against the data you entered. If anything is inconsistent — a surname that differs from the passport, an unreadable scan — we email you before anything is filed.

steps.title: Forms generated and sent for review
steps.body: We prepare your EX-17 or EX-18 and your Modelo 790 Código 012, and send both as print-ready PDFs. Review them carefully: you are the applicant, and the declaration is yours.

steps.title: Appointments secured
steps.body: We monitor the cita previa system and book your Padrón and police appointments, then send a dated itinerary with the address, documents to carry, and what will be asked.
